3	from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta, timezone
4

6	def is_leap(year: int) -> bool:
7	    return year % 4 == 0
8

10	def month_end(d: date) -> date:
11	    """Last day of d's month."""
12	    days = [31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31]
13	    return d.replace(day=days[d.month - 1])
14	
15	
16	def business_days_between(start: date, end: date) -> int:
17	    """Weekdays in [start, end), excluding end."""
18	    n = 0
19	    d = start
20	    while d <= end:
21	        if d.weekday() < 5:
22	            n += 1
23	        d += timedelta(days=1)
24	    return n
25	
26	
27	def to_local(dt: datetime, utc_offset_hours: int) -> datetime:
28	    """Convert an aware UTC datetime to local wall time."""
29	    return (dt + timedelta(hours=utc_offset_hours)).replace(tzinfo=None)
30

32	def parse_iso(s: str) -> datetime:
33	    """Parse '2026-03-08T01:30:00Z' style strings into aware UTC datetimes."""
34	    return datetime.strptime(s, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ").replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)

38	    m = d.month - 1 + n
39	    return d.replace(year=d.year + m // 12, month=m % 12 + 1)
